messages:
nina: quick heads-up — i've grouped the last month of Dedicated warmup failures. looks like three distinct failure modes repeating across pools. putting proposed owners and timelines below, want acknowledgement and any missing action items.

omar: thanks. can you paste the grouped signatures and a short example?

nina: sure. signatures: 
- udev/modprobe timeout during module init -> warmup abort
- kernel oops after vendor driver update -> node reboot loop
- race: autoscaler evicting warmup pod before shard download finishes

example: 
```
[2026-03-19T11:42:08Z] warmup: requesting shard 0/8
[2026-03-19T11:42:11Z] kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=1024, gfx error
[2026-03-19T11:42:12Z] node-monitor: pod warmup timeout -> evict
```

greg: pattern looks similar to the incidents on 2026-02-28 and 2026-03-12. any vendor rollouts around those dates?

sasha: vendor rollout on 2026-02-27 and 2026-03-10 to some pools. we have partial AMI bumps in the pipeline.

devops-bot: [ANOMALY] 1956001342 warmup_failure_spike detected for pool:redwood-dedicated-eu-02 (4 spikes in 48h)

nina: Proposed short-term mitigations (48h):
- omar: orchestrate targeted rollback for pools that saw kernel oops (owner: omar) — due 2026-03-22 EOD
- greg: add a retry and extended timeout to udev/modprobe step + more verbose logs behind FF (owner: greg) — due 2026-03-22 noon
- sasha: add temporary routing weight away from pools with >3 failures in 24h (owner: sasha) — due 2026-03-22 EOD

longer-term (2-4 weeks):
- ops-lead: add recurrence metadata to postmortem template (fields: recurrence_count, hypothesis_tag, linked_tickets) and require for infra follow-ups (owner: ops-lead) — due 2026-04-05
- infra: implement firmware/driver pin enforcement and rollout gating for Dedicated fleets (owner: omar + infra) — due 2026-04-12
- runtime: autoscaler change to use warmup lease so pods in warmup are not evicted (owner: greg) — due 2026-04-02
- observability: create "warmup-recurrence" dashboard and weekly alert for >3 pool spikes (owner: sasha) — due 2026-03-29

sasha: i'll add the routing weight change to the router config PR and test in staging.

omar: starting rollback ticket now. will include verification steps and smoke tests.

greg: i'll open a small PR for the modprobe retry; will keep behind FF and add metrics for retry count.

nina: for tracking, i've created TKT-6724 and added a recurrence table linking similar incidents. please add action items as subtasks. https://go/internal/TKT-6724

devops-bot: [INFO] TKT-6724 created and assigned to nina; priority: P1

sasha: for the dashboard, what should be the primary signal? fallback_rate or warmup_abort_count? fallback_rate surfaces customer impact but is noisy.

ops-lead: prefer fallback_rate as SLA-facing, warmup_abort_count as engineering signal. include both on the dashboard with ratios.

omar: rollback scheduled for 2026-03-21 03:00 UTC. ETA 2h. will post progress.

[~3 hours later]

omar: rollback complete on affected hosts in eu-02. warmup success on those hosts improved from 68% -> 96% over 90m. attaching brief logs to TKT-6724.

greg: modprobe retry PR staged in canary; initial results show 50% reduction in transient failures on canary nodes. will iterate.

sasha: router weight change applied in staging; no regressions seen in traffic tests.

nina: thanks all. next steps: owners to update TKT-6724 with runbooks, verification, and expected close date. schedule a 20m sync on 2026-03-28 to review recurrence metrics and decide whether to close the ticket or escalate to a broader reliability effort.

ops-lead: please add a "recurrence_hypothesis" tag to the ticket when you add an action item so the future postmortems can filter by hypothesis.

nina: noted; will update ticket template and inform PMs.

greg: tagging eng-runtime on the autoscaler lease design; will request review this week.

sasha: will own the dashboard and alerting. posting draft link to internal dash once ready.

nina: closing thread; reopen if any new spikes appear. Thanks everyone. :pray:
